retractions.claim: Calls the Monday DAY-MOVE sign 4/4 on the walk's four scorable weekend seams.
retractions.why_invalid: The play's own record contradicts it twice. Its assumption_retired block says of 0601 that consulting this gate on the state actually served 'REPRODUCES +350' against a realized -990; and the very field making the 4/4 claim writes, in its mechanism clause, '0601 leg +690 against a day of -990'. A day cannot be both a 4/4 member and a documented wrong sign. The S112 decline audit scored all four seams from the blind record: 0518 -550 vs +660 wrong, 0601 +350 vs -990 wrong, 0608 -420 vs -890 right, 0615 +320 vs +160 right. The honest tally is 2 of 4. On the six Mondays after the prior-session stub defect was fixed, the gate's owner went 3 of 6.
retractions.evidence: research/kalshi/knowledge/ng_brain.json (the play's own assumption_retired and mechanism fields) + research/kalshi/forecasts/g21_blind_round1/grp21_mbo_specialist_B.json + research/kalshi/STANDDOWN_AUDIT_S112.json
retractions.keep_as_guard_because: A 4/4 that is really 2/4 is noise, but the REASON it is 2/4 is a live warning: this gate keys on an agent output (E.monday_bias / C.conviction_verdict) rather than a served field, so no state file can ever contradict it and every miss so far has been excused by its input. That is a reason not to trust it unattended, which is exactly Greg's test for keeping something.

replacement.text: MEASURED S112 on the blind record, four scorable weekend seams: 0518 -550 vs +660 WRONG, 0601 +350 vs -990 WRONG, 0608 -420 vs -890 right, 0615 +320 vs +160 right = 2 of 4. On the six Mondays after the prior-session stub fix the gate's owner went 3 of 6.

retractions.claim: The 20260619 instance, banked as supports_or_contradicts='supports' and scored JUSTIFIED by the S112 decline audit - 'Actual -110. No second covering rally. The decline limb held on the same instrument that had fired four sessions earlier.'
retractions.why_invalid: The owning specialist declared the day VOID for this play and said so in writing. research/kalshi/forecasts/grp21_mbo_specialist_A.json, field for_the_merge_do_not_bank_this: 'Do not bank 0619 as forward evidence for structure.failed_rally_tell, for daytype.covering_giveback_self_limiting (de-triggered, not tested), or for the blind's sign channel on this day.' The instance was sourced from E's file, which did not carry A's void declaration. A de-triggered day is not a test the play passed - it is a day the play was never asked. Banking it as support inside a MECHANISM_VERIFIED play is a corrupt library entry in D32's exact sense: a day recorded as explained when it was not. AND THE CONTAMINATION PROPAGATED: the decline audit scored this row JUSTIFIED - a good, judged decline - because its batch was given E's file and not A's. Two independent passes both banked a day the owning specialist had declared never asked. That is why 'do not bank' has to be honoured mechanically rather than remembered.
